title: PHP Core
intro: Applies to: every production PHP class, whatever the framework. These rules hold in Laravel and Symfony alike; framework overlays name the framework-specific calls (`orchestration-di.md` for Laravel, the `symfony-kanon` skill's `references/symfony.md` for Symfony).

Lane boundaries: file shape (`strict_types`, `final readonly`, constructor promotion) and the Laravel calls (`app()`, `resolve()`, facades, helpers) are owned by `orchestration-di.md`; do not re-audit them here.

entries.rule: Production classes **MUST NOT** locate services at runtime; dependencies come through the constructor. A located dependency is hidden from the constructor signature, so readers and tests cannot see what the class needs. Overlays: Laravel `app()` / `resolve()` (`orchestration-di.md`), Symfony `$container->get()` (`symfony-kanon`).
entries.why: A located dependency is hidden from the constructor signature, so readers and tests cannot see what the class needs

checks.coverage: Flags calls to app(), resolve() and $container->get() in production classes.

entries.lane_note: file shape (`strict_types`, `final readonly`, constructor promotion) and the Laravel calls (`app()`, `resolve()`, facades, helpers) are owned by `orchestration-di.md`; do not re-audit them here. Laravel overlay: ORCH-008 (its `app()`, `resolve()`, `collect()` item).

entries.rule: Classes **MUST NOT** implement static `getInstance()` singletons; shared instances **MUST** be registered in the container. A container singleton binding (`$this->app->singleton(...)` in a service provider, as `integrations.md` does for connectors) is the sanctioned form, not the banned pattern.

checks.coverage: Flags a static getInstance() method on any class.

entries.rule: A class **SHOULD NOT** extend another class only to reuse one of its methods; inject the collaborator instead.
An optional collaborator **MAY** be replaced with a Null Object implementing the same interface instead of null checks in every method.
Preconditions **SHOULD** be handled with early-return guard clauses instead of nested ifs.
Code **SHOULD NOT** chain through several objects to reach a value (`a->b()->c()->d()`); ask the nearest object for what you need.
A readonly class **SHOULD** hold immutable collections or copies, not mutable objects that callers can change. `readonly` only freezes the property, not the object behind it.
entries.why: `readonly` only freezes the property, not the object behind it

entries.rule: A method **SHOULD NOT** both change state and return data for display. A command **MAY** return the id it created or the outcome or decision of the change (see the handler Result DTO rule in `orchestration-di.md` and the command/query slices in `architecture.md`).
